effects: Pulls `amount` of the vault collateral (0G OFT, 0xE422…aE4 per the init data of 0x0f11…f191) from the signer into the vault via safeTransferFrom; this spends the signer's allowance to the vault.
Credits the active shares minted for the amount actually received (balance difference) to `onBehalfOf`, not to the signer when they differ.
The deposited stake becomes slashable restaked collateral of the vault.
formats.shown: Deposit {amount} 0G OFT for {onBehalfOf} into the vault, with the vault, amount and beneficiary as fields.

findings.title: deposit: collateral constant could only be checked for one of the three deployments.
findings.evidence: descriptor metadata.constants.underlyingToken = 0xE42215BD…EaE4. This matches the collateral in the constructor init data of 0x0f1197c8…f191 (meta.json). 0x3eFE4055…f0CF and 0x641A4f59…96B5 have no source or init data in the directory (cases 1 and 2), so I could not confirm their collateral.
findings.fix: Confirm that each deployment's collateral() returns 0xE422…EaE4, or split deployments that use other collateral into their own descriptors.

findings.title: deposit: shares received and slashing exposure come from storage and are not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_); the result is credited to _activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].
findings.fix: None needed. The descriptor can't compute the share count.

effects: Burns the signer's active shares equal to previewWithdraw(amount), rounded up; the call reverts if the signer holds fewer.
Queues `amount` of collateral as a withdrawal for the next epoch and credits the withdrawal shares to `claimer`, who alone can claim it later.
The queued amount stays slashable until the epoch ends, so the claim may pay out less than `amount`.
formats.shown: Request {amount} 0G OFT withdrawal for {claimer}, with the vault, requested assets and claim owner as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the queued amount can be slashed before it is claimed, so the payout may be lower.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol onSlash reduces withdrawals[currentEpoch_+1]. withdrawalsOf() later pays pro rata from the reduced withdrawals[epoch].
findings.fix: Optionally reword the label as 'Requested assets (subject to slashing)'.

findings.title: withdraw: intent does not say the signer's stake moves to a claim owned by `claimer`.
findings.evidence: _withdraw: withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares, while the shares are burned from msg.sender. interpolatedIntent reads 'Request {amount} withdrawal for {claimer}'.
findings.fix: Use an interpolatedIntent like 'Unstake {amount}; claimable by {claimer} next epoch'.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Converts them at the current rate to collateral (0G OFT) and queues that amount as a withdrawal for the next epoch, claimable by `claimer`.
The queued assets stay slashable until claimed.
formats.shown: Queue {shares} raw shares for {claimer}, with the share count as a raw integer.

findings.title: redeem: share count is shown as an 18-decimal raw integer that people can't read.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field '#.shares' format 'raw'; case 4 shows '987654321123456789'. ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares use the collateral's 18-decimal scale.
findings.fix: Use format 'unit' with decimals 18 and base 'shares', or a tokenAmount-style rendering, so the screen shows ~0.9877 shares.

findings.title: redeem: the collateral amount queued is computed from storage and not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares()).
findings.fix: None. The descriptor can't compute it.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
Transfers withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) of collateral (0G OFT) from the vault to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}, with the vault, epoch number and recipient as fields.

findings.title: claim: the amount and token paid out are not shown; the amount comes from storage.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _claim: amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender); claim: IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount).
findings.fix: Optionally name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Claim 0G OFT withdrawal'. The descriptor can't show the amount.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed.
Transfers the sum of withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) over those epochs, in collateral (0G OFT), from the vault to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim epochs {list} to {recipient}, with each epoch and the recipient as fields.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total amount and token paid out are not shown; they come from storage.
findings.fix: Optionally name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Claim 0G OFT withdrawals'.

couldNotCheck: Deployments 1:0x3eFE40551A996e30e880D8c622E76EE194C3f0CF and 1:0x641A4f5993A8fc86fb1F26F448Ac0C0390B096B5 have no source or init data in the directory, so I could not confirm their code or that their collateral is the 0G OFT constant used for every amount.
